title: About Azizur Rahman
content: Azizur Rahman is an AI/ML enthusiast and software developer in Dhaka, Bangladesh. Education: B.Sc. in Computer Science and Engineering, Southeast University, Dhaka; CGPA 3.56/4.00. Coursework completed; internship in progress. His professional interests are AI/ML Engineering, Machine Learning, NLP, and Software Development, including AI/ML Engineer Intern opportunities. He developed multiple academic and personal software projects and worked with Python, C, C++, Java, and C#. He participated in competitive programming and ICPC contests, developed Mental Health Prediction and Student Placement Prediction projects, and contributed to a tiredness and alertness image dataset. Achievements: ICPC 2025 Regionalist, 210+ Codeforces problems solved, maximum rating 866, 2nd and 3rd place in university programming contests, and university chess tournament champion. No internship employer or role details are available.
